_about: Features that were fixed or built and must not be broken again. Each entry names the source files that implement it and the tests that guard it. tests/test_feature_ledger.py fails if a guard test or source file disappears. Add an entry in the same PR as every fix or feature (CONTRIBUTING.md section 10). hand_verified says honestly what has and has not been seen in a real QGIS session.

features.feature: Router offers 28 tool definitions per request (setting cartogen_ai/tool_router_top_k, range 12-60)
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; not measured against live model answers

features.feature: Short imperative requests ('Set the project CRS', 'Assign EPSG', 'Go to the bookmark', 'animate', 'produce') are never dismissed as pasted fragments; 'template: access_map' still is
features.hand_verified: rows A1-A3, A15 of the rc47 bundle

features.feature: 'Show the metadata of X' reads metadata and gets no task directive; creating metadata still matches the task

features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; row A5 of the rc47 bundle

features.feature: The generic Processing tool refuses a layer of the wrong geometry type before running for the Python-implemented qgis: algorithms (polygons where lines are needed); GRASS and native ids are unchanged, puts r.sunmask.datetime's point of interest inside the elevation layer, and warns when a raster result holds a single value
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; causes read from the rc48 API trace (B3: polygon layer given to a lines-only algorithm; B15: east/north outside the DEM; B7: r.circle run without max gives a one-value raster, styling then failed). CI live only, GRASS tests skip when GRASS is absent

features.feature: A plain request that one approved Processing algorithm answers (sort, rename a field, extract by expression, mask) gets no task-library directive, so the model is not steered to a mapping task's WorldPop and styling plan
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; measured offline: confident task matches over the 385 plain prompts fell from 34 to 7, over the 792 register titles from 587 to 582. Needs the rc49 hand test (rows B28, B32, B41 and OI-128)

features.feature: create_print_layout(profile=...) reads a validated JSON profile (page size, orientation, export preset, file name pattern, required elements) from the project or QGIS profile folder; unknown fields and bad values are refused by name; explicit arguments beat the profile; exports and checks of that layout use its pattern, preset and required elements

features.feature: A map profile can add the organisation's logo, masthead colours and font: logo_path (local PNG/JPG, relative to the profile folder; URLs, network paths, '..' and SVG refused), logo_position, masthead_colour, masthead_text_colour (replaced with a warning if contrast is under 3:1) and font_family (a missing font warns and the default is used); the title is narrowed so logo and title never overlap; a missing logo file warns and the layout has no logo
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; offline unit tests plus CI live (written without a QGIS install)

features.feature: A map profile can add up to 3 footer lines and a reviewer sign-off line (prepared by, reviewed by and date, status); without a named reviewer the footer says 'Draft - not reviewed', a Reviewed/Approved status needs a reviewer and a date, and require_sign_off makes a missing review a publication problem (refused unless the user gives a reason and confirms)
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; offline unit tests plus CI live (written without a QGIS install)

features.feature: A map profile can flag COD boundaries: cod_boundaries true plus the organisation's own cod_credit wording (required with the flag, refused without it; the plugin supplies none) puts that credit first on the footer's credits line, and an export of such a layout reports duplicate admin P-codes in the layers it draws as warnings
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; offline unit tests plus CI live (written without a QGIS install)

features.feature: An export re-reads the layout's profile file by name: requirements added to the file after the layout was built (require_sign_off, required_elements) apply, a review is judged by the sign-off printed on the layout, and a missing or invalid file falls back to the stored copy with a profile_note
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; offline unit tests plus CI live (written without a QGIS install)

features.feature: A layer made from a RESTRICTED or SENSITIVE layer (merge, rename, further steps; the source renamed too) is protected through lineage, not only the layer that carries the tag: the layout export gate, the export report, the atlas gate, the QA checklist and the footer classification use the same lineage walk as the cloud gate (models/egress_gate.protection_chain), an explicit PUBLIC or INTERNAL tag on the derived layer releases it, and the Sensitivity dialog says 'protected through lineage from X' instead of 'untagged'
features.hand_verified: not hand-tested; offline unit tests plus CI live (written without a QGIS install)
